official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Applications must be linked to the EDFPCIG themes: geociencias, energía, medioambiente or ciencias afines (engineering sciences and geosciences)
official.research_requirement: Doctoral thesis developed in co-tutela or co-dirección with a PUCP thesis director and a French partner-university co-director of the IRD joint unit; a one-year research stay at the French university in year 2
official.duration: Three years (36 months): year 1 thesis at PUCP, year 2 one-year research stay at the French partner university of the IRD joint unit, year 3 thesis at PUCP
official.description: The EDFPCIG is a research structure for doctoral training bringing together Peruvian and French researchers, funded by the Embassy of France in Peru, IRD and PUCP; the 2026 call awards one doctoral scholarship alternating between PUCP in Lima and a French partner university.

verification.notes: The official PUCP page and the full 2026 bases DOCX were downloaded and read: the stipend (EUR 39,576.00 total over 36 months, split EUR 10,260 / EUR 19,056 / EUR 10,260, labelled 'sujeto a modificación'), the non-monetary benefits (PUCP tuition/degree fees, French registration-fee exemption, accident insurance, French language scholarship, round-trip airfare for the France year, social-security and visa/CVEC exemptions), the single-scholarship cupo and the 16/07-15/10/2026 window with results 04/12/2026 are all published. No English proficiency requirement is stated anywhere on the official pages, so english_requirement stays null.

applicant_utility.summary: One single place is on offer, so this is effectively a national final: your project must sit squarely in geosciences, energy, environment or a related engineering field, and you need a French co-director linked to an IRD joint unit before you apply, because co-tutela or co-dirección is part of the application itself. Money-wise the package is complete - stipend, PUCP tuition/degree fees, airfare, insurance and French fee/visa exemptions - but it is structured around a three-year Peru-France-Peru rhythm you must genuinely commit to. Watch the under-40 age limit at the closing date.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Peruvian master's graduates under 40 in geosciences, energy, environmental or related engineering fields who can secure a French co-director at an IRD-linked university and commit to a three-year split doctorate.
application_readiness_checklist: Contact a French co-director at the partner universities of the IRD joint unit early and secure their willingness in writing
Decide between co-tutela (double degree, PUCP-France convention) and co-dirección (PUCP matriculation only) before drafting
Use only the official Formato-Postulacion-EDFPCIG-2026-VF Excel and the Carta-de-Compromiso template from the page
Build the documentation per numeral 3.2 of the bases, including the SUNEDU-registered master's degree
Confirm you will still be under 40 on 15 October 2026
Email becas-posgrado@pucp.pe with any doubt well before the closing date
common_rejection_risks: A project that does not map onto geociencias, energía, medioambiente or ciencias afines
No French co-director identified, or a French university outside the IRD joint unit's partners
Non-official application formats or a missing commitment letter
Turning 40 before the close of applications
Master's degree not registered with SUNEDU
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Personal expenses beyond the stipend during the three years, and any cost not listed in the non-monetary benefits; the stipend amounts are labelled 'sujeto a modificación', so do not budget to the last euro on the published figure.
document_audit: The application Excel is mandatory - a free-format PDF will not substitute
The commitment letter must be the EDFPCIG template, signed
For co-tutela, the thesis language, calendar, tuition-cost split and defence mode are set in the PUCP-France convention - agree them before signing
alerts: Figures are officially marked 'sujeto a modificación' - treat the stipend amounts as indicative
Applications close 15 October 2026 and results only come on 4 December 2026, with studies starting in 2027
During the three funded years, other academic activity is exceptional and capped at teaching one course
Past winner lists (2017-2025) are published on the same page - useful for calibrating the expected profile
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Download the bases, Excel format and commitment letter, assemble the numeral-3.2 documentation, and submit through the PUCP School of Postgraduate Studies by 15 October 2026; results are published on the page on 4 December 2026.
